heading: Birthday songs
headline: Birthday songs with Vocal U
description: Celebrate with Vocal U. Request a personalized birthday video for $5 or an in-person birthday song for $50 from the University of Minnesota a cappella group.
intro: Give someone a birthday song from Vocal U. We can send a personalized video or come sing for them in person.
support: We're a self-funded student group, and every birthday song helps us make music and put on more shows at the U.

packages.title: Birthday video
packages.description: We'll sing Happy Birthday with their name and send you the video to share.
packages.details: Let us know their name and when you need the video.

packages.title: In-person song
packages.description: We'll come to their dorm, apartment, or wherever you're celebrating to sing Happy Birthday or Birthday Sex.
packages.details: Let us know where and about what time.
